core: Adipose tissue development and thermogenic adipogenesis
name: Adipose tissue development, PPAR-regulated adipogenesis and thermogenesis
rationale: All members concern white, brown and beige fat cell differentiation, fat pad development and cold/diet-induced thermogenesis, with explicit PPAR/PPARG regulation and adipose tissue development terms that set it apart from LXR-driven lipogenesis (C2) and the thermogenesis-only neighbour (C3); it lacks the fatty acid transport and leptin members of its superset.

name: Adipose development, thermogenesis and adipocyte fatty acid handling
rationale: Members span white/brown/beige adipocyte differentiation and thermogenesis plus adipocyte fatty acid transport, fatty acid cycling, lipid droplet fusion and the leptin/fat-storage endocrine module, which distinguish it from its subset (C1), LXR/ChREBP metabolic control (C2) and lipid droplet turnover (C4).

core: Wnt secretion and non-canonical calcium signaling
name: PORCN-dependent Wnt secretion and WNT5A-ROR2 calcium signaling
rationale: All members cover porcupine-dependent Wnt ligand secretion and WNT5A-driven FZD2/FZD5/ROR2 calcium-modulating non-canonical signaling, without the planar polarity (C2), FZD4 retinal-vascular (C3) or hedgehog lipidation (C4) content, and without the canonical LRP5/DVL members of its superset.

core: Wnt ligand secretion and receptor-level signaling
name: Wnt secretion with receptor-level canonical and calcium signaling
rationale: Members combine Wnt ligand biogenesis and secretion with non-canonical Wnt/Ca2+ signaling and receptor-level canonical events (LRP5, DVL activation, extracellular Wnt antagonists), distinguishing it from its secretion/calcium-only subset (C1) and from destruction-complex-centred canonical themes (C2, C3).
